title: RIS: Ease multi index/autocomplete like experiences and getting multiple results in a single place/event
body:
Use case: Today if you want to target multiple indices at the same time you need to listen to the `search state` and pass it back to each other `` instances. Also if you want to use an external autocomplete component you need to aggregate all the data you need. API proposal: We want to simplify that. Here's a little code sample for the two use cases mentioned before. **Multi Hits** ```js //shared between all indices //only hits of the first index //only hits of the second index //only hits of the third index ``` **External Usage of an Autocomplete component** ```js const AutoComplete = connectMultiHits(({hits, query, refine}) => refine(value)} onSuggestionsClearRequested={() => refine('')} getSuggestionValue={hit => hit.name} renderSuggestion={hit =>
{hit.name}
} inputProps={{ placeholder: 'Type a product', value: query, onChange: () => { }, }} renderSectionTitle={section => section.index} getSectionSuggestions={section => section.hits} />); ``` Basically every widgets going under the `` will override the main search parameters. Under the hood it means creating a derived helper for each new index to target. What `` will do is add to each widget context the targeted index. If no multi context is found, then we use the `indexName` declared within ``. Also, in order to use an external autocomplete component we need to create a new connector that will embed all the hits, the query, and a refine function. I pushed a branch that is far away from being prod ready but that can give you an idea. https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/1f0324cbfb182a30d3d3e088cf14e240f1819463 You can try the MultiIndex story, but all the others will not work. In term of api naming we have: * MultiIndexContext * connectMultipleHits (could be connectAutoComplete) In term of modifications: * let each connector filter the right results depending on their index context. WIth this POC, i choose to modify the `searchResults` structure to include all the results. * create all the derived helpers when getting all the `searchParameters` *** I also worked on another api: ```js ; ``` I let it down for two reasons: 1. you need to mess up with the configure widget in order to get the `searchParameters` for the right index. 2. With this, you can't modify the search parameters using all the others widgets. if we want to be able to use our regular widget to configure all the indices, it means that all the `getSearchParameters` function of every widgets will need to be modified and every widgets should take an "indexName" props, which is ugly. @vvo, @bobylito : wdyt?
